forest.name: Whisperwood Forestry
forest.description: A forestry cabin, timber stands and iron outcrops. Rowan trades provisions for harvested wood.

town.name: Moonbridge Town
town.description: An occupied high street, clinic, grocer and abandoned homes. Asha needs medical dressings.

harbour.name: Tidemark Harbour
harbour.description: Working piers, a chandlery, cargo salvage and an ocean skiff. Ellis needs scrap to reopen the ferry route.

industry.name: Blackwater Works
industry.description: A damaged industrial yard with bandits, ore and repair supplies. Search the machine shop carefully.

city.name: Lunar City / Civic Quarter
city.description: A compact city quarter amid sealed towers. Recover radio components from the occupied office and help Nia restore contact.

coast.name: Eastwatch Coast
coast.description: A coastguard refuge, beach path, landing ground and an ocean supply point.

islet.name: Lantern Islet
islet.description: A separate offshore island with a lighthouse refuge, mineral deposits and a survivor. Reach it by boat or air.
